review_scope: Independent narrow review of PC13 standalone intake and frozen Stage3 preset; no hardware actions.
findings: Existing PC13 dispatcher and debounce are unchanged. A button event in idle or completed submits request 1; active stages submit 9; fault and pending STOP are preserved. Invalid preset or existing platform admission rejects before starting. Cold boot initializes no Stage3 motion request.

Cold-start mode 1 configuration includes exact slots and colors [2,1,5], ring order [2,1,3], carrier/observation, placement and recovery depths, and nonzero task ID with batch 1. Float32 values match the locked profile.

The motion flow from post-admission dispatch onward is byte-for-byte unchanged, including 2 mm/1 degree alignment, X/Z handoff 40 mm before DM, the tray-release dwell, and final zero. Pi evidence confirms one camera and one serial owner and existing forward 13/right 5 compensation.
